description: This file contains a NEON-optimized implementation of a quantized average pooling micro-kernel for PyTorch, specifically for 8x7 input blocks. It defines the function 'pytorch_q8gavgpool_ukernel_mp8x7p7q__neon' which performs vectorized integer and floating-point operations to compute pooled outputs over quantized uint8 inputs, using ARM NEON intrinsics.
